newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bukaka clarifies role in projects.
newsitem.headline: Bukaka clarifies role in projects.

text.p: Indonesian transport, energy and engineering firm PT Bukaka Teknik Utama clarified its role in a number of World Bank projects on Tuesday after reports on the subject boosted its share price in the last week.
The company said in the statement received on Tuesday that it was participating in several tenders for projects funded by the World Bank through various government agencies.
The statement said Bukaka was finalising negotiations with regional governments and private companies for new projects anticipated to start within the next year.
The statement said details would be announced at a later date.

The price of Bukaka shares rose more than 27 percent on Wednesday to 1,950 rupiah after a newspaper report that the firm had been awarded some World Bank-funded infrastructure projects in East Asia countries.
The following day the stock fell more than 14 percent to close at 1,675 rupiah after the World Bank's Indonesian office said it did not award projects directly to any company.
On Monday, Bukaka rose 200 rupiah to close at 1,825 rupiah on turnover 2.7 million shares while on Tuesday it fell 25 rupiah to 1,800 rupiah on 850,000 shares.
The statement said that directors of Bukaka had met World Bank officials in Indonesia on February 18 to discuss general issues affecting developing nations in the Asia Pacific region.
